Name: Debug "SVG" badge renders on every chart in production
Evidence: A 8px "SVG" pill is painted at top-left of each chartbox — visible at 1280px and 360px, twice on the home page. Carries no explaining comment, unlike every other non-obvious choice in this codebase.
Fix: Delete the badge span at LineChart.tsx:257-259 and MoneyFlowByYear.tsx:262-264. Trialled locally and verified clean (0 left in DOM, charts unchanged), then reverted pending owner approval.

Name: Workbook viewer's Fabula pre-scoping is undiscoverable
Evidence: The page opens with the search box reading "fab" and rows already filtered. Per WorkbookViewer.tsx:535 this is deliberate — company sheets are scoped to Fabula so other rows open on click — but the reader sees a three-letter fragment that looks like a stray keystroke, with nothing saying the grid is filtered or that 130 other agencies exist.
Fix: Not a leftover; do not just delete it. Replace the raw query text with a removable chip ("Showing: Fabula ×") so the scoping is stated and clearing it is obvious.

Name: Footer text fails contrast at 1.35:1
Evidence: Computed color srgb(0.150 0.163 0.193) on bg rgb(10,12,17) = 1.35:1. WCAG AA needs 4.5:1 for 11px body text.
Fix: `.letterpress` (globals.css:457) tints below the page floor. Raise to at least text-muted, drop opacity-80, or reserve letterpress for decorative-only text.

Name: Stray € glyph floating on the segment line-chart y-axis
Evidence: A lone "€" renders between the €20.0M and €15.0M ticks, unaligned with the axis and clipped.
Fix: Axis unit label is positioned off its anchor — either place it above the top tick or drop it since every tick already carries €.

Name: Coverage table year headers collapse into an unreadable run
Evidence: At 360px the year header row reads "201201201202202" — headers overlap with zero gap and are unreadable.
Fix: Rotate, abbreviate to two digits ('21 '22), or switch to stacked cards per AGENTS rubric #1.

Name: Top-ranked bar loses its value label
Evidence: The #1 bar spans the full plot so its label is pushed off-plot and omitted — every other row shows one. Reads as missing data.
Fix: Place the label inside the bar when the outside position would overflow (mirror the pattern already used on the gold highlighted row).

Name: "Per employee" truncated to "Per employe" in the bottom bar
Evidence: At 1280px viewport the fixed bottom bar clips the last control's label mid-word.
Fix: Bottom bar's inner track has no room reserve; widen the container or let the group wrap rather than clip.

Name: Company pill grid clips its right-most column with no affordance
Evidence: Ogilvy €8.2M / Mediacom €7.5M / Pirmoji Kava €5.6M are sliced mid-pill at the container edge; nothing signals the row scrolls.
Fix: Add an edge fade mask + scroll cue to CompanyStrip's scroller.

Name: Segment and metric pill rows clip at the right edge
Evidence: Segment pills end at "Product…" (desktop) and "Consultin…" (phone); metric tabs end at "Emplo…".
Fix: Same fix class as UX-08 — one shared scroller primitive with a fade.

Name: End-of-series line labels overlap and clip
Evidence: "Media" sits on "Digital media"; "Events" / "Production ho" / "BTL" collide into one block, and the widest clips at the container edge.
Fix: Collision-resolve the label column (nudge apart vertically) and reserve right padding for the widest label.

Name: YoY delta badges float between bars — ownership ambiguous
Evidence: +17%, +14%, +2%, -6% each sit in the gap between two bars and at different heights, so it is unclear which year each describes.
Fix: Anchor each badge above its own bar at a fixed offset from the bar top.

Name: Payroll labels butt against the revenue bar and the last one clips
Evidence: 73.2M / 86.3M / 90.6M / 93.4M start flush at the yellow bar's left edge; 93.3M (2025) is cut by the plot's right edge.
Fix: Give the labels a gap and flip them left of the bar when they'd overflow.

Name: Rankings x-axis ticks collide with zero gap on phone
Evidence: Reads "€0.00M€0.50M€1.00M€1.50M€2.00M€2.50M€3.00M€3.50M" as one unbroken string.
Fix: Thin the tick count by available width and drop the € from every tick but the first.

Name: Scatter x-axis emits duplicate tick labels
Evidence: The log axis prints "€1.0M €1.0M" and "€5.0M €5.0M" — distinct tick positions rounding to the same label.
Fix: Increase label precision or de-duplicate ticks after formatting.

Name: Scatter metric and scale controls are rendered twice
Evidence: Turnover/Revenue/Net profit/Margin %/Employees + Log/Linear appear both as a left rail inside the plot and again in the card footer.
Fix: Keep one — the footer row is the one that matches the other cards.

Name: Small rankings bars: name label spills out and collides with the value
Evidence: "Eventum Group€0.09M", "Love media€0.15M", "360 Sportas" overflowing a 12px bar.
Fix: Move the name outside the bar when the bar is narrower than the label.

Name: Highlighted bar puts its value inside the bar in low-contrast blue-on-yellow
Evidence: Fabula's €2.92M renders inside the gold bar in the accent blue; every other row has a white label outside.
Fix: Use the same outside-label treatment; if inside is intentional
column9: switch to the dark ink token.

Name: Bar fills do not match the legend swatches
Evidence: Legend: Payroll = grey, Turnover = blue. The tall bar is grey-filled with a blue outline, so the swatch does not identify the mark.
Fix: Fill the turnover bar with the turnover colour (or make the legend show outline+fill as drawn).

Name: ~120px of dead space between the data-sources block and the company strip
Evidence: Desktop home: empty band from the DATA SOURCES row down to the pill grid, and again below the pills before the fixed bar.
Fix: Tighten the header's bottom margin; rubric #3 — content should get the room.

Name: Sheets/model control rows stagger ragged across four right-aligned rows
Evidence: At 360px the 6-7 control buttons wrap into four rows with different right offsets, consuming ~470px — a third of the viewport before any data.
Fix: Use one wrapping flex row with consistent alignment and smaller controls on phone.

Name: Provenance line wraps mid-token
Evidence: "scraped 2026-" / "07-22" breaks across lines. AGENTS rubric #2 forbids atomic-token wrapping.
Fix: Wrap the date in a non-breaking span.

Name: "Every agency 2025 · by turnover" wraps atomically on phone
Evidence: Renders as "Every / agency" and "2025 · / by turnover" — both split mid-value.
Fix: whitespace-nowrap on each control; let the row scroll instead of wrapping.

Name: Empty Financials state uses a full-width card for one sentence
Evidence: A ~90px bordered card holds "No company selected — pick one above to see its financials."
Fix: Inline the hint under the heading; drop the card chrome when empty.

Name: Comma decimal used in one place only
Evidence: "+1,77%" while the rest of the app uses "€33.0M", "-6%", "€2.92M".
Fix: Route it through the shared format helper in market-rough/format.ts.

Name: Lithuanian and English labels mixed while an English toggle is offered
Evidence: Tabs read Įmonė / Finansai / Darbuotojai / Skolos and fields read Pavadinimas / Brandas next to an "English" switch that is already on.
Fix: Decide what the English toggle covers and label it accordingly — or translate the tab and field names too.

Name: Workbook and model grids are unusable at 360px
Evidence: Sheets shows only the Pavadinimas column; model shows Rodiklis with an empty value column — no figures visible at all.
Fix: Pin the first column and let the value columns scroll horizontally; or offer a stacked per-row card view on phone.

Name: Keyboard-hint clusters take ~110px of desktop hero space
Evidence: PREV YEAR / SEGMENT / NEXT YEAR and the F+arrows COMPANY cluster sit centred in the hero, disconnected from what they drive.
Fix: Move to a dismissible hint near the bottom bar they actually control.
